summary_text: The dedicated country dossier found no region-specific legal, incident or enforcement finding for this division, so it was assessed at the national score (±0.02). The 2025 Movilh annual report places Antofagasta at 2.09% of nationally documented abuse cases — up from 1.32% in 2024 — with a +45.45% year-on-year rise in 2025, the second-largest regional increase of any region, inside a national pattern where only the two biggest regions fell while the other 14 rose (national total 3,620 cases, +27.1%, a 24-year record). The dossier's warning applies: a mid-share reading here reflects documented hate diffusing into lower-visibility territories rather than safety.

sources.title: Chile | Outright International
sources.claim_summary: Outright International's Chile country overview (updated 12 March 2026): national framework — same-sex marriage and adoption since March 2022; hate-crime law with SOGI aggravation since 2012; civil unions since 2015; self-determination gender-recognition law in force since 2019; third-sex birth designation for intersex children since 2006; no ban on medically unnecessary intersex surgeries on minors but 2023 health-ministry guidance against them; 2025 first conviction for a lesbophobic femicide; societal opinion broadly positive with recent pushback on trans rights after a 2024 parliamentary commission on trans children (final report May 2025). National picture only; no Antofagasta-specific content.

sources.title: 2024 was ‘year of regression’ for LGBTQ rights in Chile
sources.claim_summary: National LGBTQ news outlet feature (19 March 2025) headlined '2024 was year of regression for LGBTQ rights in Chile', used in the dossier's national political-direction note. The cached page body retrieved only site navigation, so this summary rests on the headline and the dossier's citation. No region-specific content.

Movilh's XXIV annual human-rights report on sexual and gender diversity in Chile (2025 facts, published March 2026): national total of 3,620 discrimination cases in 2025, +27.1% and the highest on record (23% of all cases in 24 years); geographic shares — Valparaíso 46.13%, Metropolitana 23.46%, Biobío 7.2%, and Antofagasta 2.09%; 2025 movement — Valparaíso -17.56% and Metropolitana -14.35% while the other 14 regions rose, with Antofagasta +45.45%, which the report reads as hate decentralising toward territories with less public LGBTIQ+ visibility.
